title: cleanrules command line error or note
description: What the cleanrules command line writes to standard error, one line each, when it writes JSON (spec/cli.md, Errors): an error that stops the command, or a note about what it did. Not a document: it has no version.

error.description: The error's JSON form (spec/errors.md, JSON form), with the command line's own codes usage_error and io_error.

file.description: The file the error concerns, as it was given: - for standard input.

note.description: A note: its stable code (no_cases: a test run without cases; more may be added, and consumers show a note of a code they do not know by its message) and its message, free text for people.
